visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a solid black screen displaying white centered text. (2) A blond man wearing a black hoodie and white earbuds walks along an outdoor urban street during late afternoon or early evening. He holds his phone in a selfie position, looking directly into the lens and speaking animatedly. A small rectangular inset window in the upper right shows another man with dark hair in a dark blue jacket sitting in a bright indoor studio environment. (3) The blond man continues walking and talking, but his image becomes heavily pixelated and distorted with digital artifacts. He gestures with his hands, appearing to be in a video call. (4) The scene shifts to the blond man in various playful outdoor settings: sitting on a swing against a green grassy background and sliding down a bright yellow playground slide. He looks back at the camera with an exaggerated, happy expression. (5) He is then shown lying in a bed with white and tan bedding, looking sleepy and talking. The inset window remains, showing the dark-haired man watching with a neutral expression. (6) A close-up shows the blond man vigorously eating noodles from a white bowl and then biting into a large, flat piece of raw red meat. (7) The dark-haired man is shown in a full-screen close-up, frowning deeply and looking intensely frustrated into the camera. (8) Both men are now together in a bright, white-walled studio or dressing room with mirrors and lights. The blond man explains something while pointing at the dark-haired man. (9) A series of scenes shows the dark-haired man in various indoor home settings: sitting on a floor rug near a router, lying in a bed with a phone, and standing in a white bathroom, using his smartphone while looking satisfied. Large text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen throughout this sequence.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Varies between an urban sidewalk with trees and traffic, a park with a yellow slide and green grass, a clean white-walled studio with makeup mirrors, and a modern home interior with wooden floors and white walls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, triple-tone digital phone ringing chime (ding-ding-ding) introduces the call theme. High spectral brightness and fast transients set an immediate alert tone. (2) Two male voices engage in a rapid-fire, high-arousal video call conversation. One speaker sounds excited with high pitch variability, while the other maintains a moderate, slightly confused conversational tone. A faint outdoor urban noise floor with wind and distant traffic is audible. (3) A sudden 'Whoosh' transition SFX accompanies the visual glitch. The vocal track becomes intermittent with electronic crackling sounds, simulating a failing internet connection. (4) An upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM starts, featuring a strong 122 BPM kick drum and bright synthesizer pads. (5) A cartoonish 'Boing' pop SFX triggers a sequence of fun activities. Vocals remain energetic with playful shouting and laughter. (6) A sliding friction sound effect (whoosh) occurs as the character moves on the slide. BGM maintains a consistent, driving energy. (7) A deep, rhythmic snoring vocal SFX replaces the speech for a few seconds, accompanied by a shift to a quiet indoor room tone. (8) Loud, percussive chewing and slurping SFX (ASMR-style) dominate the mix, followed by a sudden, high-intensity vocal shout (Whaaa?!) from the second speaker. (9) The audio shifts to a clean studio acoustic environment. The dialogue becomes more structured and professional, yet retains high arousal for promotion. (10) A clear, enunciated broadcasting-style narration delivers promotional details over the BGM, punctuated by sharp 'Ding' and UI click SFX as graphics appear on screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Skit Sequence -> Narrative Turn (Meeting) -> Solution Presentation -> Promotional CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a humorous series of skits portraying the frustrations of a poor internet connection (lagging, glitching, and dropping out in weird situations) to introduce Taiwan Mobile's 'Double Fast' plan. It emphasizes the solution of combined 5G and Wi-Fi 6 for consistent connectivity everywhere.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal mention of the brand 'Taiwan Mobile', showcase of their 'Double Fast' service, and clear promotional text details at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced social-native advertisement that uses character-driven comedy to highlight consumer pain points before presenting a technical service solution.
